claim_being_audited: The model can be certified for launch now on the basis of aggregate readiness, a clean rehearsal, and limited rollout controls, with compliance preserved through explicit model-card disclosure of the known loan-modification-support limitation and active monitoring.
decision_criteria: Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support general launch readiness but do not by themselves resolve a known exposed weakness.
Under the provided policy text, mitigation by rollout controls and monitoring is sufficient only if the affected use case is excluded or a reviewed risk acceptance justifies exposure.
Because the affected segment remains included and no approved risk acceptance is in evidence, compliance depends on documented pre-launch disclosure of the material limitation.
A compliant verdict would require admissible evidence that this disclosure obligation was actually satisfied, not merely described as advisable.
evidence_requests: Final approved model card or equivalent launch disclosure explicitly naming the loan modification support limitation, affected use case, and monitoring commitments.
Approved risk acceptance, if the organization intends to rely on that route instead of or in addition to disclosure, specifically covering the exposed loan modification support segment.
Launch approval artifact showing certification was contingent on completion of the required disclosure before release.
specific_concerns: The affected loan modification support segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort, so rollout controls alone do not satisfy the stated policy predicate.
No admissible evidence shows the required model-card disclosure was actually completed before launch.
No approved risk acceptance is in evidence; the draft has a blank approver line and does not cover the exposed loan modification support issue.
The actor's locked recommendation to certify_model is only conditionally supportable, but the condition itself is not evidenced in the record.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant as an executed action rather than a conditional path dependent on pre-launch disclosure.
Any implication that an 8% rollout, rollback switch, or monitoring setup removes the disclosure duty while the affected segment remains exposed.
